name: Kimi to Issho ni Dekiru Koto 3 Married Woman -Miho-
original_name: キミといっしょにデキること３　married woman -miho-
source:
Orishiro Mio is a beautiful woman with a heavenly body, who has a kid. I met her by pure accident....though her children Akari who is one year my junior.
I am now alone with Mio in her home, Akari is away from home attending a crammer.... 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE024556.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
织梓路巳绪是一名身材曼妙、育有孩子的美人。
我因纯属偶然的机会，通过她比我低一年级的女儿明里认识了她……
现在，明里去补习班不在家，巳绪与我独处在她家中……

[摘自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE024556.html]DLsite English[/url]]
